about: The seats page content (PLAN_admin_seed_v01.md section 15, deliverable D7): for each question an operator seat asks, the surface where the answer lives (the admin tab, the CRM or a vendor console), the screen, saved view or integrations row, and whether the seed (run-3000, anchor 23 Sep 2026) plus that surface answers it. A no carries a one-sentence gap and the brief table it lands in (T1 to T6 on the admin brief); a yes names the table the question belongs to. Section 15's items come first on each seat, in order, one per item; screen gaps found while the admin tab was drawn and the N01 gap list follow on the seat that asks them, each with its own cause.
